review_scope: Public repository source, tests, and local synthetic-bar execution only. No provider, network, SDK, native, OS API, private config, or private capture access.

lifecycle_review.framework_path: Cerebro.run -> Cerebro.runstrategies -> Strategy._start -> observer._start -> TradeLogger.start; Strategy sets/restores _framework_starting_observer around each observer call.
lifecycle_review.snapshot: Normal attached observer start captures a fresh UUID, run id, incremented generation, started/captured times, and the five-field risk-threshold projection. Enabled thresholds require the emitted risk_threshold_configured event to match snapshot id, generation, thresholds, run id, reference and time.
lifecycle_review.readback: config_snapshot returns the same frozen TradeLoggerConfigSnapshotV1 object while active, attached, unfinalized, and unchanged; it rejects changed threshold projection/start time, detached/stopped state, or missing/mismatched receipt.
lifecycle_review.direct_start: The fake negative calls direct start() followed by direct _start() without Strategy context; no receipt is minted.
lifecycle_review.trust_limit: The Strategy context field is same-process mutable state. Root acceptance must independently bind the exact Cerebro/Strategy/observer sources and record actual Cerebro.run composition plus receipt read in Strategy.start before account calls. This receipt alone proves neither a full engine run nor provider/account acceptance.

findings.summary: No remaining source-fake blocker found for the bounded TradeLogger configuration receipt seam.

checks.receipt_identity: Exact frozen dataclass type; repeated read returns the same object; assignment to its config_snapshot_id is rejected.
checks.risk_event: Synthetic normal Cerebro flow links emitted configuration event id/generation/reference/time to the same receipt.
checks.lifecycle_negative: Direct start and direct internal _start without the Strategy observer context do not mint; mutated threshold and started_at are rejected; stopped observer read is rejected.
checks.compatibility: The related seven-file TradeLogger unit/integration subset passed.
checks.coverage_note: No dedicated detached or framework-restart negative test in the focused file; source readback checks attachment, run/generation, start time, finalized state, and current projection.
